prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent production terrain-material atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, a painterly semi-realistic 2D side-scrolling industrial science-fiction game. Create exactly FOUR broad flat rectangular material cutouts in an even 2 columns by 2 rows grid, wide landscape 2:1 sheet. Each patch is roughly twice as wide as high, FRONT VIEW of the exposed vertical ground cross-section, no perspective, no top-down view, no scenery. TOP LEFT wet dark petrol-gray rock with subtle horizontal fissures, green saline staining and faint matte mineral flecks. TOP RIGHT compact layered estuary silt with dark blue-green damp layers and subdued gray mineral seams. BOTTOM LEFT old salt-weathered stone and concrete seawall masonry, uneven low horizontal courses, muted gray-green, hairline repairs and a few restrained pale salt deposits. BOTTOM RIGHT a flat weathered retaining-wall metal material, large horizontal petrol-gray plates, restrained rusty copper seams, short flush rivets, small salt streaks, no warning stripes. These are flat continuous interior material samples, no floating 3D blocks, no projecting roof, no platforms or windows. Entire interior of each material patch fully opaque and richly detailed, nearly straight horizontal top and bottom edges and vertical sides; preserve a 48-pixel clear transparent gutter around all four patches. Fine painted texture and subdued diffuse upper-left lighting matching realistic salt-worn port structures, clear readable low-contrast game art, not a photograph, no harsh specular highlights. Palette petrol blue, saline green, damp gray, restrained rusty brown; no bright neon, no deep black outlines. True transparent PNG alpha everywhere outside the four separate rectangles. No words, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, logos, watermarks, cast shadows, checkerboard painting, people, animals, props, sky, water or ground plane. Exactly FOUR material cells, all wholly inside the image with broad transparent margins.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent production environmental sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, a painted semi-realistic 2D side-scrolling industrial science-fiction game. Exactly SIX separate small shoreline decoration sprites in an even 3 columns by 2 rows grid, wide landscape 3:2 sheet. Strict orthographic flat SIDE VIEW, level camera, no perspective tilt, each complete silhouette isolated with at least 40 pixels of true transparent margin. Top row left to right: (1) a low broad rounded dark wet basalt rock, muted petrol-gray with subtle green saline streaks, no shiny wet glow; (2) a little low cluster of five worn gray-green pebbles, pale salt rim, visibly smaller forms; (3) one short compact Fleur de sel plant: several pale sage fleshy salt-accumulating leaves growing from a tiny low basal rosette, one restrained cream seed head, original alien maritime flora, no magical glow. Bottom row left to right: (4) a short low bunch of curled turquoise-green estuary algae ribbons attached to a small dark stone, no water or glow; (5) one short industrial mooring bollard in dull rusted petrol metal with a neatly tied weathered cream rope around its waist, only the bollard and attached rope, flat bottom, no dock platform; (6) two short weathered gray-green dock planks and a small splinter resting in a low pile, visible matte wood grain and a few flush old nail heads. Fine painterly realistic brushwork, coherent diffuse top-left lighting, restrained dark petrol blue, saline green, damp gray, pale cream and small rusty brown accents, clear silhouettes readable at game scale. No foreground ground patch beneath any sprite, no cast shadows, no extra separate props, no blooming light. All six grounded silhouettes share a horizontal baseline within their own cell, full unclipped shapes, generous alpha margins, no touching. True transparent PNG alpha background outside and between silhouettes, no checkerboard painting. No text, captions, numbers, border, grid lines, logos, watermark, people, animals, weapons, buildings, sea, sky or horizon. Original game world, no recognizable franchise elements.
